article_title_id: Fungsi & Manfaat Kincir Air di Tambak Udang
article_title_en: Function and Benefits of Paddlewheel Aerators in Shrimp Ponds

images.prompt: Photorealistic aerial-low photograph of a row of 7 paddlewheel aerators churning brackish green water in an intensive vannamei shrimp pond at sunrise, taken from the earthen dike edge looking inward, strong motion blur on spinning paddles, brilliant white water spray catching golden-orange sunrise light, healthy green phytoplankton-tinted pond water, Indonesian coastal aquaculture setting with morning mist, warm golden-hour color palette, shallow depth of field with far paddlewheels softly blurred, professional aquaculture trade publication quality, no humans in frame, no text overlays, no watermarks, no logos, no anatomical errors, no dead animals, photorealistic, 16:9 aspect ratio.
images.alt_id: Barisan kincir paddlewheel berputar di tambak udang vaname saat matahari terbit dengan semburan air putih
images.alt_en: Row of paddlewheel aerators spinning in a vannamei shrimp pond at sunrise with white water spray
images.caption_id: Kincir paddlewheel beroperasi di tambak vaname intensif pada pagi hari — saat paling kritis untuk menjaga DO ≥4 ppm sebelum fitoplankton mulai berfotosintesis. Listrik aerasi menyumbang sekitar 15% biaya produksi per siklus.
images.caption_en: Paddlewheel aerators running at dawn in an intensive vannamei pond — the most critical window for holding dissolved oxygen above 4 ppm before phytoplankton photosynthesis resumes. Aeration electricity accounts for roughly 15 percent of total production cost per cycle.

images.concept: Top-view diagram of a square shrimp pond showing 4 paddlewheels at corners creating circular flow toward central drain, orange flow arrows, blue-orange flat design
images.prompt: Clean flat-design technical schematic illustration showing a top-down bird's-eye view of a square shrimp pond, four paddlewheel aerator units positioned at the four corners each angled 35 degrees inward toward the pond center, thick curved orange arrows flowing from each paddlewheel unit forming a unified clockwise circular current pattern across the whole pond, a filled star symbol at the geometric center of the pond labeled with a bracket placeholder [CENTRAL DRAIN], the circular current arrows converging toward the center star, soft blue fill for pond water area, grey rectangles for the paddlewheel units, clean white dike border around the pond, bracket placeholders for labels [CIRCULAR FLOW] along the main current arrows, educational diagram style with minimal line weight, flat modern palette of sky blue and deep orange on white background, no photographs, no realistic textures, no text rendered as real characters (use bracket placeholders only), 16:9 aspect ratio, no logos, no watermarks.
images.alt_id: Diagram tampak atas tambak udang persegi menunjukkan posisi 4 kincir di sudut dan aliran melingkar menuju central drain di tengah
images.alt_en: Top-view diagram of a square shrimp pond showing 4 paddlewheels at corners with circular water flow arrows converging on the central drain
images.caption_id: Posisi kincir di sudut tambak dengan sudut 30°–45° terhadap dinding menciptakan arus melingkar yang menggiring sedimen, feses, dan sisa pakan ke central drain di pusat. Pola ini adalah kunci efektivitas pembuangan limbah dasar tambak.
images.caption_en: Paddlewheels angled at 30–45 degrees from the dike wall at each corner generate a unified circular current that drives feces, uneaten feed, and molted shells toward the central drain. This flow pattern determines how effectively the bottom waste is evacuated between cycles.
images.fallback_note: AI generators (including FLUX) frequently produce schematic diagrams with misaligned arrows, inconsistent geometry, or absent/garbled label placeholders. If the generated PNG lacks clear directional arrows and a distinct center point, replace with a hand-drafted CAD export or commission a vector illustration. A suitable stock alternative: Adobe Stock search 'shrimp pond aeration diagram top view circular flow' or 'paddlewheel aerator pond schematic'. Editor should QC this image before publishing.

images.concept: Infographic showing aerator needs per stocking density scenario: 3 pond size cards (0.3 ha, 0.5 ha, 1 ha) with icons and 2 HP unit counts, blue-teal flat modern palette
images.prompt: Clean modern flat-design vertical infographic illustration showing three side-by-side pond size scenario panels, each panel contains a simple top-down pond outline icon in teal, a small paddlewheel aerator icon, and a bracket placeholder number [N UNITS] beneath the icon, three panels arranged horizontally from left to right representing small, medium, and large pond sizes with bracket placeholders [0.3 ha], [0.5 ha], [1 ha] as size labels, each panel has a bracket placeholder [STOCKING DENSITY: 100/m2] subtitle, the panels use soft teal and blue gradient fill cards on a white background, clean sans-serif icon style, no real text characters rendered (all text positions shown as bracket placeholders only), horizontal divider line separating a title area at the top from the three scenario cards below, modern aquaculture infographic aesthetic, 16:9 aspect ratio, no logos, no watermarks, no photographs.
images.alt_id: Infografis tiga skenario kebutuhan unit kincir 2 HP untuk tambak udang berukuran kecil, sedang, dan besar
images.alt_en: Infographic showing required 2 HP paddlewheel unit counts across three shrimp pond size scenarios: 0.3 ha, 0.5 ha, and 1 ha
images.caption_id: Kebutuhan kincir meningkat proporsional dengan luas tambak dan padat tebar. Pada tambak 0,5 ha intensif 100 ekor/m², minimal 8 unit kincir 2 HP diperlukan untuk mempertahankan DO ≥4 ppm — tambahkan 20–30% faktor keamanan untuk kondisi malam dan suhu tinggi.
images.caption_en: Aerator requirements scale proportionally with pond area and stocking density. A 0.5-hectare pond at 100 shrimp per square meter needs at least 8 units of 2 HP paddlewheels to hold dawn DO above 4 ppm — add 20 to 30 percent as a safety buffer for night-time and high-temperature conditions.
images.fallback_note: Text-bearing infographics are consistently the weakest output from generative image models — the bracket-placeholder approach avoids garbled characters but the layout and icon arrangement may still be poor. If FLUX output lacks clear three-panel structure and readable layout proportions, this image should be rebuilt in Canva, Figma, or Adobe Illustrator using the caption data and the sizing table from the article (rows: 0.3 ha = 5 units, 0.5 ha = 8 units, 1 ha = 15 units at 100/m²). A stock-photo fallback is not appropriate for this data-driven visual; commissioned vector work is the correct path.
